text: Musk, Bezos and Zuckerberg raced to Mars. Winner owns the planet. Musk launched first. Forgot the fuel. Bezos launched second. His rocket was delivered to the wrong planet. Zuckerberg built Mars in the metaverse. Nobody came. Musk finally landed. A sign was waiting. Private property. Rent is due. The landlord was a lizard. Now Musk sleeps in his rocket. Which billionaire goes to Mars? One way.
